We never had a rule about it before - there were instances in which teams that were being temporarily ran by an owner made trades, I know in at least one of them, the trade was facilitated by the original owner before disappearing. The trades were posted for the league and no concerns were brought up. That to me is different than team that are being permanently run by the same owner. 



I received several sitemails concerning this, and so while rules about it were vague before, I feel it’s important to have a clear guideline going forward as we do have several owners running multiple teams.
